8.3.6.3.2 Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio
[SWS_Dem_00981] Definition of API function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRa-
tio
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈
Service Name
Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio (
uint32* SPN,
uint16* Numerator,
uint16* Denominator,
uint8 ClientId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x9a
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
ClientId
ClientId to address the J1939 event memory
Parameters (inout)
None
SPN
Receives the SPN of the applicaple system monitor. If the return
value of the function is other than E_OK the out parameters of
this function do not contain valid data.
Numerator
Receives the Numerator of the applicable system monitor. If the
return value of the function is other than E_OK the out
parameters of this function do not contain valid data.
Parameters (out)
Denominator
Receives the Denominator of the applicable system monitor. If
the return value of the function is other than E_OK the out
parameters of this function do not contain valid data.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Operation successful
DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT: The requested element is not available
DEM_PENDING: Operation successful and result pending.
DEM_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL: The provided buffer is too small
Description
Gets the next filtered Ratio.
Available via
Dem_J1939Dcm.h
⌋
